preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 2 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a_i, b_i <= n and a_i != b_i
preconditions.description: Each edge in the tree is between two distinct vertices, each with a label between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of operations required is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: For each test case, the output must result in a bamboo tree.
postconditions.description: The final tree must have no node with a degree greater than 2.

postconditions.expression: For each operation, the edge must be present in the graph at the moment of removal.
postconditions.description: Each edge that is removed must be a part of the initial tree configuration.

postconditions.expression: The output must include all possible edges that can be added to achieve the bamboo structure.
postconditions.description: The output must cover all necessary edge additions to transform the tree into a bamboo.

invariants.expression: The tree is a connected graph with no cycles.
invariants.description: Each tree is a connected graph without any cycles, ensuring it can be transformed into a bamboo.

invariants.expression: The bamboo tree has no node with a degree greater than 2.
invariants.description: The final tree must have all nodes with a degree of either 1 or 2, fulfilling the bamboo structure.
